reader_job: Scan current state, identify the priority exception and affected metric, then locate the next action and source note.
use_scenario: Internal component value review for a repeat-use operational dashboard
review_tasks: Locate the next action and source note.
rollback: Remove the component marker and enhanced state styles; baseline.html retains the same control, content, and reading order.

fallback.static_html: The current state, exception, metric, action, and owner detail remain readable without CSS state change.
fallback.reduced_motion: The control changes state without animation.
fallback.ppt_handoff: Print shows the owner handoff detail and hides the interactive checkbox.

non_claims: This controlled pilot does not prove production or real-user value.
The local fixture is not a live operational feed.
